<thought>Search the template catalog for retrosynthetic templates that break an aryl halide (C‑Br) bond on an aromatic ring, using bromobenzene (c1ccc(Br)cc1) as the target molecule. This should return a template whose mapped reaction shows the formation of a C‑Br bond in the forward direction (electrophilic aromatic bromination). The returned entry provides the mapped reaction SMILES and a numeric reaction/template ID.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{"molecule_smiles": "c1ccc(Br)cc1", "functional_groups_broken": ["halide"], "limit": 20}</action_input>
